title: Alefay Kombil
subtitle: Frontend Developer
text: I build clear, dependable interfaces for web applications and WordPress sites. I often work from an idea or design through reusable components, practical UI/UX decisions, integrations and deployment, collaborating closely with developers, managers and clients along the way. My earlier work in hospitality, events and team coordination taught me to ask useful questions, communicate clearly and understand how people use a service day to day. Frontend development remains the centre of my work, with backend and API contributions, website maintenance and hosting support giving me the breadth to help projects reach and stay in production.
